behaviour_summary: Source-backed draft contract covers preferences, channels, delivery attempts, readiness, suppression, and audit posture.
notes: Lineage evidence; fresh USF proof added in this branch.

behaviour_summary: Controlled notification intent/message/delivery/evidence model with exact classification, tenant scope, safe views, and lifecycle state.
notes: Replaces the prior thin tenant notice wrapper.

behaviour_summary: Typed templates with version, hash, classification, allowed variables, allowed channels/classes, approval fields, immutable-after-use posture, and no arbitrary code execution.
Recipient identity separated from address_ref with verification/status/source fields and address hashing in provider/audit evidence.
Channels email, sms, push, in-app, webhook, provider-internal, and test are modeled with provider modes, allowed classifications, verification, size, retry, suppression, and redaction posture.
notes: Only in-memory/local-test provider runtime is implemented.

behaviour_summary: NotificationProvider port and in-memory adapter use secret-reference provider config, fail-closed validation, local/test/mock modes, and live-external-deferred posture.
notes: No live external provider implementation or readiness claim.

behaviour_summary: notification.delivery jobs use notification-job classification, tenant scope, service actors through PR #98 substrate, idempotency key, and value-free payload refs.
Duplicate delivery submissions deduplicate; retries are bounded; provider failures are redacted; exhausted retry records dead-letter evidence.
Preferences, consent, unsubscribe status, suppression status/reason/source, bounce/complaint posture, and do_not_contact are represented and audited.
Feedback event types and suppression status fields are represented; live inbound provider webhook handling is deferred.
notes: No open/click tracking; privacy-sensitive tracking disabled by default in standard.

behaviour_summary: Notification lifecycle audit events are canonical; audit metadata is value-free and excludes raw address, body, provider credentials, and raw provider errors.
Future API/UI notification behaviours are documented and proven at capability level only; no notification HTTP routes or UI are implemented.
notes: OpenAPI remains free of raw notification data.

behaviour_summary: Fresh proof, validator, planted defects, source-use, and parity matrix backing exist for the notification/messaging slice.
